categories.main_business_segments: Global New Material International Holdings Limited primarily operates in the production and sales of pearlescent pigment products and functional mica and related products. The Group's business segments include natural mica-based, synthetic mica-based, glass flake-based, silicon oxide-based, aluminium oxide-based, and aluminium-based pearlescent pigment products, as well as functional mica fillers and new energy materials. The Group also engages in strategic business units in the PRC and Korea.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for producing high-end pearlescent materials, synthetic mica, and new energy materials. It emphasizes independent research and development, product iteration, and innovative upgrades, including patented technologies such as a pearlescent pigment for water-based ink and its preparation method. The production methods focus on green manufacturing and eco-friendly processes, with a strong emphasis on sustainable and resource-saving production models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves both trading company customers, who resell products, and end user customers who use the products for their own production purposes. Its products cater to industries requiring high-performance pearlescent pigments and functional mica, including cosmetics, coatings, inks, and new energy sectors. The Group's markets include domestic customers in the PRC and international customers across Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in the PRC and the Republic of Korea, with significant production facilities and business presence in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China, and Korea. It has expanded its market reach to Europe, North America, South America, Africa, and other parts of Asia, including Southeast Asia. The Group also has offices and production bases in Hangzhou and Shenzhen, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Global New Material International operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying advanced pearlescent pigment products and functional mica materials. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing through strategic partnerships with top raw material suppliers and downstream sales through trading companies and direct end users, thus covering a broad spectrum of the supply chain but mainly positioned as a producer and supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on internationalization, corporatization, and innovation driven by materials science. It prioritizes green manufacturing, advanced materials, and intelligent applications. R&D efforts concentrate on product upgrading, technological breakthroughs in synthetic mica, pearlescent materials, and new energy materials, and establishing a global collaborative R&D mechanism. The Group also aims to integrate newly acquired businesses to enhance technology and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: The Group generates revenue primarily through the sale of pearlescent pigment products, functional mica fillers, and new energy materials. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, including both trading companies and end users. The business model includes product sales across various geographic markets, with a focus on high-value-added products and expanding international sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the Group positions itself as a global leader in the surface performance materials industry, particularly in high-end pearlescent pigments and synthetic mica products. The acquisition of Merck KGaA's Global Surface Solutions Business and the integration of CQV in Korea strengthen its competitive position and global market influence, aiming to consolidate dominance in the global surface performance materials sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB1.65 billion, a 55% increase year-on-year, and net profit of approximately RMB320 million, a 50.2% increase. EBITDA rose by 65.9% to approximately RMB613 million. The Group has shown strong growth driven by market expansion, product mix optimization, and strategic acquisitions, with total assets exceeding RMB7 billion and liabilities around RMB2.7 billion as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and environmentally friendly pearlescent pigment products and functional materials. Its value proposition includes a broad and diverse product portfolio with over 2,000 pearlescent pigment products, strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, and a commitment to green manufacturing and sustainability. The integration of global resources and strategic acquisitions enhances its ability to offer full-scenario application ecosystems, meeting diverse customer needs with superior product performance and service.
